newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-GREEKS THROW PARTY TO CELEBRATE EURO TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-GREEKS THROW PARTY TO CELEBRATE EURO TITLE.

text.p: Thousands of Greeks poured into the streets of cities around the country on Thursday for an all-night party after Olympiakos won the European clubs' basketball crown.

The empty Athens streets came alive with hundreds of cars blaring their horns and fans dancing, waving flags and jumping in pools moments after the Greek club won the televised EuroLeague final in Rome by beating Spain's Barcelona 73-58.

"We waited for this crown since 1974," said Haris Nikolakis, one fan who was dressed in the club's red and white colors as he headed for the central Omonia square to join the celebrations. "This is the biggest day in Olympiakos' history."

Government ministers, opposition leaders, state organisations and supporters sent congratulatory telegrams to the club's headquarters and a big showing was expected on Friday at Athens' airport when the players return.

"We proved today that we are the biggest force in European basketball," club president Socratis Kokkalis told Greek reporters in Rome. "I believe that the reign of Olympiakos in Europe has just begun."
